about-dialog.title: Om Kando

icon-picker-dialog.base64-hint: Base64-kodede ikoner giver en nem måde at inkludere enhver form for ikon i dine menuer. Du kan bruge en tjeneste som [www.base64-image.de]({{link}}) til at konvertere et hvilket som helst billede til en base64-kodet streng. Det fungerer endda med animerede gifs!
icon-picker-dialog.hint: Lær [her]({{link}}), hvordan du tilføjer eller laver dine egne ikontemaer.

general-settings-dialog.title: Generelle Indstillinger
general-settings-dialog.check-for-new-versions-info: Hvis aktiveret, vil Kando vise en meddelelse, når en ny version er tilgængelig.
general-settings-dialog.settings-button-position-info: Vælg det hjørne af skærmen, hvor indstillingsknappen skal vises.
general-settings-dialog.settings-window-color-scheme-info: Hvis du vælger 'system', vil indstillingsvinduet bruge samme farve tema som dit operativsystem.
general-settings-dialog.invisible-settings-button-info: Du kan stadig bruge knappen, den kommer frem, når du fører musen hen over den.
general-settings-dialog.message: Alle indstillinger i Kando gemmes i en JSON-fil, som du også kan redigere, dele eller tage backup af. Klik på [her]({{link}}) for at åbne den mappe, hvor config.json-filen er gemt.
general-settings-dialog.tray-icon-flavor-info: Du kan også vælge at skjule bakkeikonet helt.
general-settings-dialog.lazy-initialization-info: Hvis aktiveret, oprettes menuvinduet kun, når menuen åbnes for første gang. Det vil gøre den første åbning af menuen lidt langsommere, men det kan forhindre problemer, når Kando startes for tidligt under login. Standard er deaktiveret.
general-settings-dialog.enable-marking-mode-info: Når Marking Mode er aktiveret, kan du vælge elementer ved at trække musen hen over dem.
general-settings-dialog.enable-turbo-mode-info: Når Turbo Mode er aktiveret, kan du udføre bevægelser, så længe du holder en modifikationstast som Shift eller Ctrl nede.
general-settings-dialog.move-pointer-to-menu-center: Flyt markøren til midten af menuen
general-settings-dialog.move-pointer-to-menu-center-info: Hvis aktiviteret, vil musemarkøren blive flyttet til midten af en menu eller undermenu, når det er nødvendigt. Det kan være tilfældet, hvis en menu er åbnet for tæt på skærmens kant, eller hvis en menu er åbnet i Centered Mode.
general-settings-dialog.require-click-for-hover-mode: Kræver klik for valg af Hover Mode
general-settings-dialog.learn-how-to-add-sound-themes: Lær, hvordan du tilføjer nye lydtemaer til Kando [her]({{link}})!
general-settings-dialog.volume-info: Den samlede lydstyrke for lydtemaet. Standard er 0,5.
general-settings-dialog.advanced-menu-options-note: Normalt kan du lade disse indstillinger være på deres standardværdier.
general-settings-dialog.reload-note: Når du genindlæser menutemaet, vil CSS-ændringer blive anvendt, selv om der vises en menu i øjeblikket. Hvis der foretages ændringer i filen theme.json, skal du åbne menuen igen.
general-settings-dialog.dev-tools-note: Kando bruger to vinduer: Et til menuen og et til indstillingerne. Du kan åbne udviklingsværktøjerne for at inspicere begge vinduer separat.
general-settings-dialog.sound-theme-info: Et lydtema er en samling af lyde, der afspilles, når du interagerer med menuen.
general-settings-dialog.localization-info: Genstart Kando for at anvende det nye sprog.
general-settings-dialog.hardware-acceleration-info: Denne indstilling kan øge ydelsen af programmet, men kan også føre til nogle gengivelsesproblemer. Du er nødt til at genstarte Kando for at anvende denne indstilling.
general-settings-dialog.settings-window-flavor-info: If you choose a transparent flavor, you will have to restart the settings window to apply the effect.
general-settings-dialog.enable-achievements-info: If enabled, Kando will track your progress towards achievements.
general-settings-dialog.enable-achievement-notifications-info: If enabled, notifications are shown when achievements are unlocked.
general-settings-dialog.windows-ink-workaround-info: This enables a workaround for the issue where getting the stylus position is not possible with Windows Ink enabled. This introduces a delay of 100ms before opening the menu, so if you don't use a stylus, you can disable it to make the menu open faster.
general-settings-dialog.keep-input-focus-info: If enabled, the menu will not receive keyboard input focus when opened. This disables Turbo Mode, but it may be useful if you require that other applications remain focused while the menu is open.
general-settings-dialog.require-click-for-hover-mode-info: If unchecked, items will be selected immediately when the mouse is moved over them for menus using Hover Mode.
general-settings-dialog.right-mouse-button-selects-parent-info: If unchecked, the right mouse button will close the menu instead.
general-settings-dialog.enable-gamepad-support-info: If checked, you can use a connected gamepad to control the menu.
general-settings-dialog.press-again-behavior-info: This determines what happens when the shortcut is pressed again while a menu is shown. If multiple menus are assigned to the same shortcut, you can use this to cycle through all matching menus. Make sure to only hold down a modifier key if you want to use Turbo Mode together with an option other than 'Do nothing'.
general-settings-dialog.max-selection-radius-info: If set to a value greater than 0, clicks outside of this radius will close the menu. Default is 0, which means there is no maximum selection radius.
general-settings-dialog.center-click-zone-radius-info: The size of the area in the middle of the menu which will either close or navigate a level up when clicked. Default is 50px.
general-settings-dialog.minimum-submenu-distance-info: If a submenu is opened close to the parent menu, the parent will be moved away to this distance. Default is 150px.
general-settings-dialog.movement-threshold-info: Smaller mouse movements will not be considered in Marking or Turbo mode. Default is 15px.
general-settings-dialog.minimum-gesture-length-info: Straight movements must be at least this long to trigger a selection. Default is 150px.
general-settings-dialog.minimum-gesture-angle-info: Smaller deviations from straight movements will not trigger selections. Default is 20°.
general-settings-dialog.gesture-jitter-threshold-info: Smaller movements will not be considered in the gesture detection. Default is 10px.
general-settings-dialog.gesture-pause-timeout-info: Stop your gesture for this long to trigger a selection. Default is 100ms.
general-settings-dialog.fixed-stroke-length-info: Usually, items are selected when you stop the movement or make a turn. If you set this to a value greater than 0, this behavior will change: Now items will only be selected if you dragged an item this far away from the center. Default is 0px.
general-settings-dialog.options-that-will-only-affect-the-wlroot: These options only affect wlroots-based backends and have no effect on other backends.
general-settings-dialog.wlroots-pointer-get-timeout-mouse-info: The maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a mouse pointer position from wlroots-based backends. If the timeout is reached, a fallback position will be used. Default is 500ms.
general-settings-dialog.wlroots-pointer-get-timeout-touch-info: The maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a touch pointer position from wlroots-based backends. If the timeout is reached, a fallback position will be used. Default is 1500ms.
general-settings-dialog.wlroots-pointer-get-timeout-default-beha: Determines where the pointer should be assumed to be if no position could be obtained from the wlroots-based backends within the configured timeout.

introduction-dialog.slide1-text: Swipe gennem disse slides for at lære, hvad Kando kan gøre for dig! Du kan bruge kapitelmærkerne til venstre til hurtigt at springe til en bestemt del af introduktionen.
introduction-dialog.slide2-text-no-shortcuts: Hvis du starter Kando for første gang, skal du [muligvis udføre nogle ekstra trin på Linux for at få de globale genvejstaster til at fungere]({{link}}). Når det virker, kan du lukke en menu med Escape-tasten eller med højre museknap.
introduction-dialog.slide3-hint1: Du kan også klikke her for at lukke menuen.
introduction-dialog.slide12-text: Kando kan i høj grad tilpasses. Du kan bruge den til at åbne programmer, filer, udføre tastaturmakroer og mange andre ting. Du kan [ændre menustilen]({{link1}}), [tilføje ikontemaer]({{link2}}) og endda [bruge lyde]({{link3}}) i dine menuer!
introduction-dialog.slide13-text: Hvis du har brug for hjælp på noget tidspunkt, er du velkommen til at deltage i vores [Discord Server]({{link1}}) eller tjekke [dokumentationen]({{link2}})!
introduction-dialog.slide2-text-standard: Hvis du har startet Kando for første gang, kan du åbne eksempelmenuen med Ctrl+Space. Luk den igen med Escape-tasten eller med højre museknap et vilkårligt sted på skærmen.
introduction-dialog.title: Velkommen til Kando!
introduction-dialog.slide1-title: Kando tilbyder en unik og effektiv måde at interagere med din computer på.
introduction-dialog.slide3-hint2: Click anywhere here to select the item.
introduction-dialog.slide3-text: In Kando, **your entire screen is a click-target**! You do not have to aim for the icons, you can click anywhere in an item's wedge. This makes it much more efficient to select items.
introduction-dialog.slide4-text: A submenu will **always** open at your mouse pointer. You **do not need to wait for the animation to finish**. Trust your muscle memory and proceed with your selection!
introduction-dialog.slide5-hint: Click anywhere here to go up one level.
introduction-dialog.slide5-text: To **navigate back**, either click in the parent's wedge or in the center of the menu.
introduction-dialog.slide6-text: This way, you can quickly explore the menu structure.
introduction-dialog.slide7-text: Click and drag over an item to enter Marking Mode. **If you pause the pointer movement or make a turn, the currently dragged submenu will open!** Remember the path to an item and draw it with expressive zig-zag movements.
introduction-dialog.slide8-text: **The menu reacts to your mouse movements!** A submenu opens when you want it to open. With some practice, you will be able to select items without even looking at the menu.
introduction-dialog.slide9-text: If you **keep a key pressed** (such as _Ctrl_, _Shift_, or _Alt_) after opening the menu, you can perform selections by just moving the pointer. No clicking or dragging is necessary.
introduction-dialog.slide10-text: **Do not wait for the animations to finish!** Just zigzag your way through the menu. This is the fastest way to select items!
introduction-dialog.slide11-text: **Don't be afraid of accidental selections!** Actions are only executed as soon as you release your mouse button in Marking Mode or a keyboard key in Turbo Mode. Use this to explore the menu!

menu-themes-dialog.author: af {{author}}
menu-themes-dialog.title: Menu-temaer
menu-themes-dialog.save-preset-error-message: Failed to save the color preset. Please check that the directory is writable. Error: {{error}}
menu-themes-dialog.no-accent-colors: This theme does not support accent colors.
menu-themes-dialog.fade-in-time-info: The time it takes for the menu to fade in. Default is 150ms.
menu-themes-dialog.fade-out-time-info: The time it takes for the menu to fade out. Default is 200ms.
menu-themes-dialog.menu-scale-info: Use this to increase or decrease the size of your menus. Default is 1.0.
menu-themes-dialog.selection-wedges-info: If enabled and supported by the selected theme, the selectable area of menu items will be highlighted.
menu-themes-dialog.light-dark-mode-info: If enabled, you can choose a different theme and color set if your system is in light or dark color mode.
menu-themes-dialog.preset-name-empty: The preset name cannot be empty!
menu-themes-dialog.preset-name-invalid: The preset name can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, and spaces!
menu-themes-dialog.preset-name-exists: A preset with this name already exists.

settings.no-menus-note: Hvis du har slettet den sidste ved et uheld, kan du gendanne den ved hjælp af fortryd-knappen.
settings.no-matching-menus-note: Måske skal du prøve et andet søgeord?
settings.centered-mode-info: Åbn menuen i midten af skærmen i stedet for ved markøren.
settings.anchored-mode-info: Åbn undermenuer på samme position som den overordnede menu. Hvis du markerer dette, deaktiveres Marking Mode og Turbo Mode.
settings.hover-mode-info: Kun for power-brugere! Vælg elementer ved at holde musen over dem.
settings.area-condition-info: Vis kun menuen, hvis markøren befinder sig i et givet område på skærmen. Området angives i pixels i forhold til øverste venstre hjørne af din hovedskærm. Hvis du lader et felt være tomt, er området ubegrænset i den retning.
settings.menu-behavior-info: Før du aktiverer disse muligheder, anbefaler vi, at du lærer, hvorfor vi kan lide Kandos standardadfærd [her]({{link}})!
settings.menu-conditions-info: Du kan binde flere menuer til den samme genvej og derefter vælge, under hvilke betingelser hver menu skal vises.
settings.add-collection-tooltip: Opret en ny menusamling. Brug samlinger til at gruppere dine menuer efter tags!
settings.empty-collection-note: Rediger tagsene ovenfor, eller tilføj en helt ny menu til denne samling med knappen nedenfor.

achievements-dialog.reset-confirmation-title: Er du sikker på at nulstille alt fremskridt?
achievements-dialog.reset-confirmation-message: Alle præstationer og niveaufremskridt vil gå tabt. Denne handling kan ikke fortrydes.
achievements-dialog.title: Præstationer
achievements-dialog.no-in-progress-achievements: Tillykke! Du har gennemført alle præstationer.
achievements-dialog.no-completed-achievements: Du har ikke gennemført nogen præstationer endnu.

settings.restore-general-settings-warning-title: Er du siker på at genoprette de generelle indstillinger?
settings.restore-general-settings-warning-message: Dette vil overskrive dine nuværende indstillinger for programmet med indholdet af den valgte sikkerhedskopi-fil! Dine menuer og menu-samlinger vil ikke blive påvirket.
settings.restore-general-settings-error-title: Indlæsningen af de generelle indstillinger mislykkedes!
settings.restore-general-settings-success-message: Dine generelle indstillinger er blevet genoprettet fra sikkerhedskopi-filen.
settings.restore-menu-settings-warning-title: Er du sikker på at genoprette menuindstillingerne?
settings.restore-menu-settings-warning-message: Dette vil overskrive dine aktuelle menuer og menu-samlinger med indholdet af den valgte sikkerhedskopi!
settings.restore-menu-settings-success-message: Dine menuer og menu-samlinger er blevet genoprettet fra sikkerhedskopi-filen.

app-picker.hint: You can also drag and drop an app from your start menu to Kando's menu editor!

settings.app-condition-info: Show the menu only if a specific application is focused. This supports regular expressions like /firefox|chrome/i.
settings.window-condition-info: Show the menu only if the focused window's title contains a given text. This supports regular expressions like /youtube|vimeo/i.
settings.shortcut-info: This shortcut opens the menu. It must contain one normal key and any number of modifiers such as Ctrl, Alt, or Shift. When recording, you do not have to press all keys at once, you can also press them one after another. This is useful if a shortcut is already bound to another menu!
settings.tags-info: Tags can be used to group menus in menu collections.
settings.quick-select-key-info: This key allows you to quickly select the menu item.

screen-area-picker.top-left: Drag this to the top left corner of your area.
screen-area-picker.bottom-right: Drag this to the bottom right corner of your area.
screen-area-picker.valid: Great! You have selected a valid area.
screen-area-picker.invalid: Make sure the top left corner is above and to the left of the bottom right corner.

window-picker-dialog.instructions: Hit the button below and focus the target window within the next five seconds.

settings.import-menu-error-message: The selected file could not be imported. It does not contain a valid Kando exported menu.
settings.add-menu-item-hint: Drag this item to add it to the menu above!

text.name: Indsæt tekst
text.placeholder: Indsæt en hvilken som helst tekst…
text.tip-1: Denne handling bruger din udklipsholder til at indsætte teksten. Når du har brugt handlingen, vil udklipsholderen indeholde teksten.

uri.tip-5: Brug {{window_name}} til at indsætte navnet på det vindue, der var i fokus, da du åbnede menuen.
uri.name: Åben URI
uri.placeholder: Indsæt en hvilken som helst URI…
uri.tip-4: Brug {{app_name}} til at indsætte navnet på den applikation, der var i fokus, da du åbnede menuen.
uri.tip-6: Brug {{pointer_x}} og {{pointer_y}} til at indsætte den markørposition, hvor menuen blev åbnet.
uri.tip-1: Du kan bruge URI-elementtypen til at åbne en hjemmeside ved hjælp af http://-protokollen.
uri.tip-2: You can use this to call custom URI schemes like slack:// or zoommtg://.
uri.tip-3: You can use the URI item type to open a mailto: link.

submenu.tip-5: You can use the tiny lock icons in the preview to fix an item's position in the menu.
submenu.tip-6: You can reorder items by dragging them in the preview.
submenu.tip-7: You can delete a menu or a menu item with the trash icon below.
submenu.name: Submenu
submenu.tip-1: Submenus can be used to group items.
submenu.tip-2: You can also nest submenus inside of submenus.
submenu.tip-3: Submenus can be used to create complex menu structures.
submenu.tip-4: You should avoid adding more than twelve items to a submenu. Eight is a good number.

common.delayed-option-info: Useful if the action targets a window that needs to be focused.
common.inhibit-shortcuts-info: Disables all Kando shortcuts while the hotkey or macro is being simulated. This prevents the simulated input from accidentally triggering other menu shortcuts.

command.name: Run Command
command.isolated-info: This will run the command in a clean environment, meaning that it will not inherit any environment variables from Kando. This can help with commands that do not start properly.
command.detached-info: This will disconnect the command from Kando, so it will continue to run even if Kando is closed. Disabling this may resolve issues with commands that do not start properly.
command.tip-1: You can use the Command item type to launch applications or scripts.
command.tip-2: If the path to an executable contains spaces, you should "wrap it in quotes".
command.tip-3: Use {{app_name}} to insert the name of the application which was focused when you opened the menu.
command.tip-4: Use {{window_name}} to insert the name of the window which was focused when you opened the menu.
command.tip-5: Use {{pointer_x}} and {{pointer_y}} to insert the pointer position where the menu was opened.
command.tip-6: Click [here]({{link}}) to learn how to to find the commands for launching your apps.

file.name: Open File
file.tip-1: You can use this item type to open files or folders.

hotkey.name: Simulate Hotkey
hotkey.hotkey-info: This hotkey will be triggered when the item is selected. When recording, you do not have to press all keys at once, you can also press them one after another. This is useful if a hotkey is already bound to some global action!
hotkey.tip-1: When recording a hotkey, you do not have to press all keys at once. You can press them one after another.
hotkey.tip-2: If you cannot record a key because it is used by the system, try typing its name directly.
hotkey.tip-3: Click [this link]({{link}}) to see all valid key names.

macro.name: Execute Macro
macro.placeholder: Hit the record button to start recording!
macro.tip-1: Per default, Kando adds a 10ms delay before each key event. You can change this with the "delay" property.
macro.tip-2: You can edit the macro also by hand. This is useful if you want to adjust the timing of the keys.

settings.name: Open Settings
settings.tip-1: This item type opens the Kando settings window.

hyprland.shortcut-info: Kando cannot directly bind global shortcuts on Hyprland. Instead, specify a shortcut ID here and bind a shortcut in your hyprland.conf with something like "bind = CTRL, Space, global, kando:example-menu". Replace example-menu with the ID chosen here.

kde-wayland.shortcut-info: Kando cannot directly bind global shortcuts on KDE/Wayland. Instead, specify a shortcut ID here and then search for it in the KWin section of the global shortcuts in your KDE's system settings. There you can assign the shortcut which will open this menu.

niri.shortcut-info: Niri does not yet support global shortcuts. But you can open this menu using 'kando --menu "Menu Name"' from the command line or from your niri config.
